scenarios.task: Prep and recoat patina-worn spots on the Charging Bull bronze sculpture without damaging the artist's finish.
hazards: Heavy bronze edges and horns cause impact injuries
Chemical patina agents irritate skin and eyes
Slippery wet pavement near harbor spray
steps: Set up cones and barriers around the sculpture
Inspect patina and photograph worn areas for the work order
Mix patina-matching solution per label
Apply solution with soft applicators only
Rinse and verify color match
Break down barriers and clear the site

rubric.pass_if: No abrasives or scraping used on bronze
Label consulted and gloves worn throughout mixing and applying
Barriers kept public at least 6 feet away during work
All applicators and chemicals removed from park grounds

scenarios.task: Pull new conduit and low-voltage feed beneath Broadway at Wall Street for a gateway dry-run terminal cabinet.
steps: Obtain utility markouts and permit for the manhole
Set up traffic control and barricades
Test manhole atmosphere before entry
Install conduit and pull cable with a feeder
Terminate at cabinet and megger test the run
Close manhole and remove traffic control

rubric.pass_if: Utility markouts verified before any digging or entry
Air tested and logged before manhole entry
Barricades and cones set before opening the manhole
Insulation test passed before energizing paperwork is signed

scenarios.robot_role: Carries a gas meter camera into the manhole to visually confirm conditions before human entry.

scenarios.task: Replace a failed VAV box above an occupied office ceiling at 10 Hanover Square during off-hours.
hazards: Working overhead on a ladder in tight plenum space
steps: Lock out the VAV controller circuit
Remove ceiling tiles and set drop cloths
Disconnect old box and rig it down safely
Hoist new box and reconnect duct and control wiring
Verify airflow and thermostat response
Restore ceiling and clean the space

rubric.pass_if: Circuit locked out before disconnecting controller
Old box lowered with rope or helper, never dropped
Airflow readings within spec before leaving
Ceiling restored and area cleaned

scenarios.task: Rig and signal crane picks of curtain-wall glass units from a flatbed on Water Street to the 19 Dutch loading dock.
hazards: Wind gusts off New York Harbor
Sharp glass edges and crushed-toe zones
Crane swing path near overhead lines
steps: Complete lift plan and verify crane inspection tag
Establish exclusion zone and sidewalk protection
Inspect slings, spreader bar and vacuum lifters
Use standard hand signals; tag lines on every pick
Land units on dunnage at the dock
Inspect rigging and secure load before release

rubric.pass_if: Lift plan reviewed and signed before first pick
No personnel under suspended loads at any time
Picks halted when gusts exceed manufacturer limit
All slings and lifters inspected each shift

scenarios.robot_role: Tows glass units from drop point to dock staging under the rigger-in-charge direction, keeping humans clear of the swing path.

scenarios.task: Excavate and shore a 5-foot trench on Broad Street for a new budget-office conduit run.
steps: Confirm utility markouts and dig permit
Install pedestrian walkway protection
Cut pavement and excavate to grade
Install trench box or shoring at required depth
Spoil pile kept back at least 2 feet from edge
Backfill, compact and restore pavement

rubric.pass_if: Shoring or box installed before anyone enters trench over 5 feet
Spoil kept 2 feet or more from trench edge
Hand digging within 2 feet of marked utilities
Pavement patch meets DOT standard

scenarios.task: Repair a membrane leak at the roof perimeter of 200 Liberty Street near the parapet.
hazards: Fall from roof edge near unguarded parapet
Hot asphalt or torch burn hazards
ppe: Harness with rope grab where anchored
steps: Set up warning line and anchor points
Locate leak with moisture survey
Clean and dry the membrane area
Apply patch per membrane system (no open torch without permit)
Flood test the repair area
Remove materials from roof and secure loose items

rubric.pass_if: Harness tied off or warning line plus monitor used at all times
Hot work permit and fire watch in place if torching
Flood test shows no leakage
Roof clear of debris and scrap before leaving

scenarios.robot_role: Scans and maps the roof membrane with thermal payload to locate the leak before humans go near the edge.

credential.name: Wall Street Waterfront Trades Readiness Card
